name: rtm.start
purpose: Deprecated: Starts a Real Time Messaging session. Use rtm.connect instead.

simple_latest.desc: Return timestamp only for latest message object of each channel (improves performance).

no_unreads.desc: Skip unread counts for each channel (improves performance).

mpim_aware.desc: Returns MPIMs to the client in the API response.

presence_sub.desc: Only deliver presence events when requested by subscription. See presence subscriptions.

batch_presence_aware.desc: Batch presence deliveries via subscription. Enabling changes the shape of presence_change events. See batch presence.

no_latest.desc: Exclude latest timestamps for channels, groups, mpims, and ims. Automatically sets no_unreads to 1.

include_locale.desc: Set this to true to receive the locale for users and channels. Defaults to false.

safety_note_for_agents: This catalog documents Slack's UNDOCUMENTED/internal API surface for a specific workspace (Hack Club, Enterprise Grid). Calling an undocumented method with params_known=false means you would be guessing params against a real backend with unknown side effects -- do not do this against a real account/token without a human in the loop, and never call anything shaped like a write (*.delete, *.set, *.remove, *.create, *.update, and similar) without explicit human confirmation and a clear understanding of the blast radius, even when params_known=true. 'existence-only' verified does NOT mean 'safe to call' -- it only means the method name is real.
